text:
The Last Iron Lung Update
Pre-Order the DVD and Blu-ray Here ► https://ironlung.com/
Video From Covert Film ► https://youtu.be/fbA4bjlqVpM&t=2422

It's finally time! Mark your calendars for December 13th for the big Iron Lung explanation stream and BTS deep dive and also pre-order your Iron Lung DVD and Blu-ray today, the menus and content of which were assembled by @NerdFiction! Also available is a special edition pin set from Jason Vines, the SFX make up artist from the movie!
